records.body: Fast #1187 is green on current production main `b9547e3598c4ca575098ae20c9732e38884154b2`. records.body:

Reuses the existing TaskReportPdfRenderer plus merged WorkAgenda adapter/projection for grouped Jalali day/range PDF output. No second report/PDF/store/model foundation. Focused renderer tests preserved.

Keep Draft for exact-head Fast; `arvin-auto` lets the now-fixed Production Orchestrator promote, dispatch Heavy and merge serially only on current main.
